replays.section('summary', (el, ctx) => { el.textContent = 'Sandboxed summary for ' + ctx.replay.meta.title; });
replays.track('errors', (ctx) => ctx.replay.console.filter((entry) => entry.level === 'error').map((entry) => ({ atMs: entry.at, label: entry.message.slice(0, 160), tone: 'error' })));
